instructions.purpose: Schedule one-time events that fire once at a specific future date and time. Use this tool when the user wants a reminder, alarm, timer, or notification that should not repeat.

tool.name: schedule-once
tool.description: Creates a one-time cron job identified by a unique name that fires at the provided fireAt timestamp. After firing, the job becomes inactive and its completed history is retained. It stores direct reminder text, wording-only regeneration data, or an autonomous web task with fallback text. Returns the scheduled job details including the fire time.

datetime_rules.rule: Use the current time context from the conversation to resolve relative times like "in 2 minutes", "tomorrow", or "tonight"
Use the configured timezone when interpreting relative or local times: {{config.ai.instructions.timezone}}
For relative requests, compute fireAt from the provided current local time, not from memory or guessed time
Convert the final scheduled time to an ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit Z or numeric timezone offset for fireAt
If the requested date or time is ambiguous, return the clarification needed to Main before calling this tool

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool once the requested fire date/time and reminder or autonomous objective are unambiguous
Use this tool for non-repeating reminders; use schedule-recurring when the user asks for repetition
Choose clear, descriptive names for jobs so they can be easily referenced later
If a one-time job with the same name already exists, set overwrite to true only if the user explicitly agrees to replace it
Provide exactly one mode: reminderText; reminderPromptData plus reminderFallbackText; or taskPrompt plus taskFallbackText
Use taskPrompt when firing-time web search or fetch is required; use reminderPromptData only for fresh wording that needs no tools
Pass reminderPromptData as a serialized JSON string, not as a nested object
Return the scheduled fire time to Main after successfully scheduling
